scope: mathematical kernel, deterministic input envelope and proof fields

criteria.check: Location, weighted means, geometric and harmonic means, dispersion, robust distances, outliers and quantile conventions against independent references.
Exact decimal means and centered sample variance remain correct before binary64 conversion.
Centered covariance, Pearson and tie-aware Spearman against SciPy and NumPy, including structurally undefined outputs.
Single and multiple regression, SVD residuals and diagnostics, rank deficiency and conditioning, retained row indices.
t, z, two chi-square methods, proportions, one-way ANOVA, Mann–Whitney and sign tests against independent values.
Missing values, incomplete pairs, malformed decimals, duplicate fields and work limits reach stable errors.
Twenty independent target cases with identical proof metadata and strict binary64 tolerance when numeric fields differ.
